threads.body: [Bug] The generated Java source is added to the main source set, but only `compileJava` depends on `generateInstrumentationVersionClass`. In mixed Kotlin/Java projects (several instrumentation modules use `org.jetbrains.kotlin.jvm`), `compileKotlin` runs before `compileJava`, and Kotlin compilation can reference Java sources from the source set—so it needs the generated file to exist too. Without wiring this, applying this plugin to a Kotlin-based instrumentation module will fail to compile if Kotlin sources reference the generated `InstrumentationVersion` class.

replies.body:
Fixed in https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/commit/cd7d9f4b1f5fb335dead9f17a85b6d6e2903b29f.

Wired the generated version-class task into Kotlin compile/source tasks as well as Java compile/source tasks.

threads.body: [Maintainability] `checkstyleMain` excludes only `**/InstrumentationVersion.java`, but the plugin allows configuring an arbitrary fully-qualified class name. If a module sets a different simple class name, the generated source will be checked and may violate header/format rules. Excluding the generated source directory is more robust and matches the actual intent (generated code).

replies.body:
Fixed in https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/commit/81a9ecc4739fbe6be26569cb25858e923b5a8dc5.

Changed Checkstyle to exclude the generated version-class source directory instead of only a specific generated filename.
